svg.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 52 nodes and 60 edges. flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: S1 human start, S1-specific trigger wired?, entry is hand or generic supervisor.. Key relationships: S1 human start points to S1-specific trigger wired?; S1-specific trigger wired? points to entry is hand or generic supervisor with label: no: generic SessionStart and launchd run exist; slash start and portal --check do not; S1-specific trigger wired? points to intake.requirements.fleet none=A, 1to8=B, else=C with label: yes: ompo then slash start then SessionStart portal --check.. Layout spans 3581 by 6512 units with 52 rendered node boxes and 60 routed edge paths.
